<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_invst_pln.CostPlanBreakdownCreationHelper</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Cost plan breakdown helper for finding and creating breakdowns</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>CostPlanBreakdownCreationHelper</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var CostPlanBreakdownCreationHelper = Class.create();
CostPlanBreakdownCreationHelper.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    findOrCreateBreakdownRecordForEntity: function(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType) {
        var breakdownRec = this.findBreakdownRecordForEntity(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType);
        if (breakdownRec.getRowCount() == 0) {
            this.createbreakdownRecordForEntity(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType);
            return this.findBreakdownRecordForEntity(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType);
        }
        return breakdownRec;
    },
    findBreakdownRecordForEntity: function(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType) {
        const breakdownRec = new GlideRecord('cost_plan_breakdown');
        breakdownRec.addQuery(entity, entityId);
        breakdownRec.addQuery('breakdown_type', breakdownType);
        breakdownRec.addQuery('fiscal_period', fiscalPeriod);
        if (!gs.nil(costType)) {
            breakdownRec.addQuery('resource_type', costType);
        }
        if (!gs.nil(expenseType))
            breakdownRec.addQuery('expense_type', expenseType);
        breakdownRec.query();
        return breakdownRec;
    },
    createbreakdownRecordForEntity: function(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType) {
        var breakdownRec;
        if (!gs.nil(expenseType)) {
            this.createCostPlanBreakdownRecord(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType);
        } else {
            this.createCostPlanBreakdownRecord(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, 'capex', breakdownType);
            this.createCostPlanBreakdownRecord(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, 'opex', breakdownType);
        }
    },
    createCostPlanBreakdownRecord(entity, entityId, fiscalPeriod, expenseType, breakdownType, costType) {
        const breakdownRec = new GlideRecord('cost_plan_breakdown');
        breakdownRec.initialize();
        breakdownRec.fiscal_period = fiscalPeriod;
        breakdownRec.breakdown_type = breakdownType;
        breakdownRec.expense_type = expenseType;
        if (!gs.nil(costType)) {
            breakdownRec.resource_type = costType;
        }
        breakdownRec[entity] = entityId;
        breakdownRec.insert();
    },
    type: 'CostPlanBreakdownCreationHelper'
};]]></script>
